episodes.title: Welcome to the Playground
episodes.summary: Orphaned sisters Vi and Powder bring trouble to Zaun's underground streets in the wake of a heist in posh Piltover.

episodes.title: Some Mysteries Are Better Left Unsolved
episodes.summary: Idealistic inventor Jayce attempts to harness magic through science — despite his mentor's warnings. Criminal kingpin Silco tests a powerful substance.

episodes.title: The Base Violence Necessary for Change
episodes.summary: An epic showdown between old rivals results in a fateful moment for Zaun. Jayce and Viktor risk it all for their research.

episodes.title: Happy Progress Day!
episodes.summary: With Piltover prospering from their tech, Jayce and Viktor weigh their next move. A familiar face re-emerges from Zaun to wreak havoc.

episodes.title: Everybody Wants to Be My Enemy
episodes.summary: Rogue enforcer Caitlyn tours the undercity to track down Silco. Jayce puts a target on his back trying to root out Piltover corruption.

episodes.title: When These Walls Come Tumbling Down
episodes.summary: An eager protégé undermines his mentor on the council as a magical tech rapidly evolves. With authorities in pursuit, Jinx must face her past.

episodes.title: The Boy Savior
episodes.summary: Caitlyn and Vi meet an ally in Zaun's streets and head into a frenzied battle with a common foe. Viktor makes a dire decision.

episodes.title: Oil and Water
episodes.summary: Disowned heir Mel and her visiting mother trade combat tactics. Caitlyn and Vi forge an unlikely alliance. Jinx undergoes a startling change.

episodes.title: The Monster You Created
episodes.summary: Perilously close to war, the leaders of Piltover and Zaun reach an ultimatum. But a fateful standoff changes both cities forever.

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Crown
episodes.summary: Vi and Caitlyn wrestle with how best to respond in the wake of a terrible tragedy that claims lives — and escalates tensions between the twin cities.

episodes.title: Watch It All Burn
episodes.summary: With Piltover ready for war, the Undercity weighs its options. Jinx lies low and plots her next move. A pivotal conversation takes place.

episodes.title: Finally Got the Name Right
episodes.summary: Caitlyn doubles down on her hunt for Jinx. Ambessa accepts a fateful meeting. Changes in Zaun lead to a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Paint the Town Blue
episodes.summary: As rumors of Jinx's return swirl, Ambessa pursues her target with renewed enthusiasm. Jinx and Sevika go undercover and into the belly of the beast.

episodes.title: Blisters and Bedrock
episodes.summary: Vi awakens to surprising news. An unsettling reunion isn't what it seems. Caitlyn uncovers the origins of Shimmer.

episodes.title: The Message Hidden Within the Pattern
episodes.summary: Healing comes from a familiar face — in an unfamiliar place. A stunning betrayal threatens to change countless lives.

episodes.title: Pretend Like It's the First Time
episodes.summary: A moment of darkness, a moment of light — and a vision of What Could Have Been.

episodes.title: Killing Is a Cycle
episodes.summary: A brewing storm fuels a series of startling transformations. Elsewhere, the spark of rebellion still burns.

episodes.title: The Dirt Under Your Nails
episodes.summary: Magic. Science. Power. Revenge. Destinies clash in an epic final chapter, igniting an all-out war.
